dish.title: Persian Ghormeh Sabzi: Herb and Lamb Stew with Dried Lime
dish.description: Iran's beloved herb stew: lamb shoulder braised with a mountain of slow-cooked parsley, cilantro, scallions, and fenugreek, kidney beans, turmeric, and whole dried limes that lend a deep, sour, almost smoky tang. Served with fluffy steamed basmati.

recipe_version.title: Persian Ghormeh Sabzi: Herb and Lamb Stew with Dried Lime
recipe_version.description: Iran's beloved herb stew: lamb shoulder braised with a mountain of slow-cooked parsley, cilantro, scallions, and fenugreek, kidney beans, turmeric, and whole dried limes that lend a deep, sour, almost smoky tang. Served with fluffy steamed basmati.

ingredients.name: scallions
ingredients.preparation: green and white parts finely chopped

ingredients.name: dried limes
ingredients.preparation: pierced 3 times each with a knife

ingredients.name: basmati rice
ingredients.preparation: rinsed until the rinse runs clear

ingredients.name: neutral oil
ingredients.note: 3 tbsp lamb, 2 tbsp herbs, 2 tbsp rice

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Wash and thoroughly dry the parsley, cilantro, and scallions, then chop them very finely (a food processor in short pulses works). Dice the onion. Cube the lamb and pat it dry. Pierce the dried limes. Rinse the basmati until the rinse runs clear and leave it in the strainer. Drain and rinse the beans, and juice the lemon.

steps.title: Brown the lamb
steps.body: Heat 3 tbsp oil in the Dutch oven over medium-high. Brown the lamb in two batches, 4 minutes per batch. Add the onion and cook until golden, 5 minutes, then stir in the turmeric and pepper for 30 seconds.

steps.title: First simmer
steps.body: Add the 5 cups water and 2 tsp salt, scraping up the browned bits. Bring to a boil, cover, and simmer on low 30 minutes.

steps.title: Cook down the herbs
steps.body: While the lamb simmers, heat 2 tbsp oil in a 12-inch skillet over medium-low. Add the chopped parsley, cilantro, and scallions and cook, stirring every minute or so, until they darken to deep green and smell toasty, about 15 minutes; stir in the fenugreek for the last minute. Do not let them scorch. Runs inside step 3 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Braise with the limes and beans
steps.body: Stir the herbs, dried limes, and beans into the lamb. Cover and simmer on low 60 minutes, stirring occasionally and pressing the limes against the side of the pot after 30 minutes, until the lamb is fork-tender and the stew is thick with oil glistening on top.

steps.title: Parboil and steam the rice
steps.body: During the braise, bring 12 cups water and 2 1/2 tsp salt to a boil in a large pot. Add the rice and boil 6 minutes until just tender outside and firm in the center; drain. Return the pot to medium heat with 2 tbsp oil, mound the rice in, poke 4 holes with a spoon handle, wrap the lid in a kitchen towel, cover, and steam on low 30 minutes. Runs inside step 5 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.body: Stir in the lemon juice and taste for salt and sourness. Serve the stew beside the fluffed rice, one dried lime per bowl (squeeze it for more tang, but do not eat the shell).
